name: kinetik
description: Research social-content ideas, create and refine media, and preview posts before approving publication.

interface.longDescription:
Your screen time is high enough already. Kinetik is your AI agent for social media: it edits reels, generates videos and carousel posts, and suggests trends and new post ideas every day.

Kinetik helps you:
• Create trending carousels and posts in minutes: give Kinetik a topic and get every slide plus a ready caption in your brand voice.
• Turn your own photos into this week's trending effects, from a template or a custom effect.
• Edit your reels or generate short videos: send a raw clip or an idea and get a finished reel with cuts, a hook and on-screen graphics, sized for Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.
• Publish when you're ready: approve a post and Kinetik puts it on your Instagram or sends a video to your TikTok drafts.
• Get data-driven recommendations: Kinetik analyzes the trends and your content performance, then suggests topics, hooks and formats.

Connect your Kinetik account to start.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Instagram and create a 7-slide carousel
Edit my raw video into a reel and suggest 3 hooks
Show me the top 3 viral trends I can use this week. Update weekly.

publication.release_notes: Ask which format a post you're planning should take: Kinetik recommends one for Instagram, LinkedIn or X, with similar posts that took off.
